source: explicit index of the two evidence bundles retained for the Codex native runtime gate

rules.retained: only floor (the oldest qualified release) and latest (a recent qualified release) are committed; git history keeps every earlier bundle
rules.bundle_selection: look up the role name (floor or latest); never pick a bundle by version, lexically or semantically
rules.qualified: a qualified bundle is complete evidence for a release inside the gate in theater/harness/builtin/plugins/codex/runtime_plan.py
rules.latest_refresh: a bump rewrites latest only when the captured evidence differs; installed_release.json (binary identity) is not compared
rules.candidates: freshly captured releases live under candidates/ untracked and are never interpreted as supported
